cat > /root/div_cal_verify/run_medium_uncurated_seed456.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# GPT2-medium (355M) uncurated (100% data) self-iterate experiment
# Model: gpt2-medium | Seed: 456 | 8 generations | 500K tokens/gen
# Training: lr=5e-5, epochs=3, batch_size=4, grad_accum=8 (effective=32)
set -e
source /root/div_cal_verify/env.sh
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

GPU_ID=${1:-0}
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU_ID

echo "===== GPT2-medium UNCURATED seed=456 ====="
echo "GPU: $GPU_ID"
echo "Start: $(date)"

python3 /root/div_cal_verify/run_mvp.py \
    --method uncurated \
    --student_model gpt2-medium \
    --self_iterate \
    --no_quality_filter \
    --data_dir /root/div_cal_verify/data_gpt2 \
    --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/div_cal_verify/results_medium_uncurated_seed456 \
    --num_generations 8 \
    --gen_tokens 500000 \
    --train_epochs 3 \
    --train_lr 5e-5 \
    --train_batch_size 4 \
    --train_grad_accum 8 \
    --seq_len 512 \
    --gpu_ids 0 \
    --seed 456

echo "===== COMPLETE ====="
echo "End: $(date)"
SCRIPT
